requirements.text: Customers should be able to select a service, choose their barber, view available appointment times, and receive immediate confirmation of their booking.
Customers should have the ability to cancel or change their appointments without needing to call the shop.
Each barber should be able to log in to the system to set their own working hours, breaks, and days off.
The system should send a confirmation notification immediately after a booking is made.
The system should send reminder notifications via text or email one day and one hour before the appointment.
The system should effectively manage bookings to prevent double-booking.
The system should allow barbers to update their availability easily without causing disruption to current processes.
Customers should pay for their appointments in person when they arrive.
